releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.14
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.14

This alpha update lets you install, update and remove WoW from the Play screen without opening Battle.net. It also adds a touch layout editor, controller help in Battle.net, and lower CPU use after you enter the world.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Install, update and remove games from Play.** Pick a game version on Play to **Install** it, or pick an installed one to **Play** or **Update**. **Verify** and **Uninstall** sit below **Open Battle.net**. They run through Battle.net's own installer without opening the Battle.net window, and a progress screen shows the download size, speed and time left. Uninstall keeps your add-ons.
- Play shows when the selected game has an update.
- **Account** on Play lists the WoW licenses Battle.net shows for the selected game, such as WoW1 and WoW2. Pick one and Play starts that license. Each game remembers its own choice.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.13
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.13

This alpha update adds a floating game window and automatic Android keyboard support. It also reduces background CPU use and fixes several touch and graphics issues.

Install over your existing version to keep your data.

## What's new

- **Floating game window** is on by default. When you switch apps, the game can keep playing in Android's picture-in-picture window, capped at 20 FPS. Tap the window and use its expand button to return to full screen. You can turn it off in Settings. The background setting is now called **Keep running in background**.
- The Android keyboard opens when a WoW text field gains focus and closes when you finish typing. It stays closed while a hardware keyboard is connected.
- The game surface requests 60 Hz while you play, including during touch input, to reduce display power use on high-refresh-rate phones. WeHavePhones also cleans up leftover Wine processes shortly after a session ends.
- **Disable WoW voice chat** is on by default to reduce background CPU use. Turn it off in Settings if you use WoW's built-in voice chat.

## Touch controls

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.12
releases.body:
# WeHavePhones 0.0.12

An alpha update fixing a controller regression in 0.0.11.

Install over your existing version to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.**

## Touch controls

- The action wheel is now enabled by default on wide screens. Turn off **Menu → Touch controls → Action wheel** to use standard action bars. Existing saved choices are preserved.

## Fixes

- Moving the left stick on a controller no longer presses the D-pad too, so D-pad bindings in WoW only fire from the D-pad. This fixes a regression in 0.0.11 (#39).

## Validation

- All 14 host suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.
- Forever 1.60.1.70938 passed in the signed 0.0.12 RC on a Galaxy S23+. Controller UI persisted after an in-game exit and relaunch. World entry and jumping passed with default controls.
- Touch controls passed world entry, jumping, stick movement and camera turning. The wheel passed swipes in both directions, hub taps and casting Healing Touch from an existing slot.
- Settings were restored and controller UI returned after the touch tests. No new Android crash entries appeared.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.11
releases.body:
An alpha update with redesigned touch controls, lower graphics memory use and controller fixes.

Install over 0.0.10 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Major change to touch controls

The new touch action wheels have four rings of nine slots using WoW's Action Bars 6 to 8. Swipe around the hub or tap it to change rings, tap a slot to use it, and hold a slot to change it.

**Existing touch-control users may need to re-add their spells and items to the new wheels.**

![Redesigned touch controls with the action wheel](https://github.com/ashmerra/wehavephones/releases/download/v0.0.11/WeHavePhones-0.0.11-touch-controls.png)

## What's new

- Added 75%, 90% and 110% touch interface sizes. The movement stick, toolbar and other native touch controls now resize with the interface, at a gentler rate to keep them easy to tap.

releases.name: WeHavePhones 0.0.10
releases.body:
An alpha update focused on touch controls, launch reliability and addon apps.

Install over 0.0.9 to keep your data. **Do not uninstall first.** Setup → App update can install the published release for you.

## Changes

- Touch chat starts compact when you enter the world and expands when you use it. Its controls stay clear of page keys and the keyboard.
- The touch quest tracker sits below the player frame. Play-mode drags turn the character, and the current touch mode is easier to see.
- Fixed taps missing their target when the Android keyboard pans the game screen.
- Fixed an exited WoW process blocking the next launch.
- Disabled Wine audio codec drivers that delayed Battle.net startup. Previous controlled S23 measurements reached the Play button about six seconds sooner.
- Fixed WowUp hanging at its logo with a backport of Wine's large-message fix. Removed the obsolete WowUp app patch.
- Added automated game and addon app checks for contributors.

## Testing and limitations

- All 13 host check suites, the E2E runner self-test, ShellCheck, Ruff and Android Lint passed.

releases.name: Cemu 2.6
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Exporting saves via the title manager no longer crashes when the export path contains unicode characters
- Fixed a regression in DS Virtual Console titles (#1440)
- Fixed a bug where the debug shader dumping option would try to write files to the wrong directory
- Added a right-click context menu to the PPC debugger disassembly view and fixed some smaller bugs in the debugger
- Use libusb as the backend for HID/USB devices on Windows (#1471)
- Reduce amount of Vulkan sampler objects that are created. Reduces memory usage slightly and avoids crashes on drivers that have a low limit on sampler objects
- Improved index data caching on Vulkan. This may provide a very small performance benefit in some games
- The `--force-interpreter` command line option now always uses single-threaded CPU emulation like originally intended

releases.name: Cemu 2.5
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Upscaling and downscaling options in the graphics settings now work correctly on Vulkan. Previously, the hermite and bicubic scaling options would only work on OpenGL and silently fall back to bilinear filtering on Vulkan
- Graphic pack support for custom scaling shaders has been reworked and is now functional on Vulkan, with fixes carrying over to OpenGL. If you are a graphic pack developer see #1392 for details
- Cemu will now show an error if the MLC directory is not writeable
- Added a workaround for graphic driver crashes seen in the eShop versions of Fatal Frame. These are caused by the game shipping with shaders that contain infinite loops. The actual hardware has an escape mechanism for this that we don't yet emulate
- Added support for connecting Wiimotes via L2CAP on Linux (Details in #1353)
- Set correct version for MacOS bundle
- Updated Arabic, German, Russian and Swedish translations

releases.name: Cemu 2.4
releases.body:
**Changelog:**
- Added emulated Dimensions Toypad
- Fixed a corruption bug which could occur when reading from titles in .app/.wud/.wux format under rare circumstances
- Cemu will now validate all reads for .app/.wud/.wux format titles and log any detected errors to log.txt. In the future we will also show these errors on screen
- Reworked the Wii U error dialog implementation (ErrEula) for better accuracy. This should fix the bug where sometimes the error dialog was unskippable in some games
- Fixed a bug in the HLE implementation of proc_ui.ProcUIRegisterCallback/ProcUIRegisterBackgroundCallback

releases.name: Cemu 2.3

- Vulkan: Fixed a race condition where uniform data could get corrupted. Most commonly this would cause polygon corruptions in BotW or XCX but in theory could affect every game
- Vulkan: Changes to how frame display is handled to reduce input latency
- Input: Fixed a crash that could occur when closing the add controller dialog while a controller search was still active
- Amiibo: Fixed an issue where Amiibo were not detected in Mario Kart 8
- Online: SpotPass functionality now respects the proxy_server option in settings.xml
- Windows: In portable mode shortcut save icons will now be stored to the Cemu directory instead of %appdata%
- Misc: Fixed a crash that could occur when invalid command line parameters were passed to Cemu

新增：视频实时翻译，识别视频或游戏正在播放的对白，以双语对照悬浮字幕显示原文和译文，没有原字幕也能使用。支持本地模型或在线识别，需要 Android 10 及以上版本。

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.17: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.
- **Cierres que dejaron de aparecer.** Con la versión anterior ya no hemos vuelto a ver el cierre más repetido de Most Wanted al arrancar, ni el de Underground 2 en la preparación de los reflejos. Si te vuelve a pasar, envía el reporte desde el launcher.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.16: LAN sin bloqueos y reportes más completos

### Cambios

- **Crear carrera LAN ya no detiene el juego si tu `server.dll` es de otra versión.** Antes salía "Arranque guest detenido: server.dll: file layout does not match the lifted code" y el juego se paraba. Ahora aparece un aviso: ese teléfono no puede crear la carrera, pero sí unirse a una que cree otro jugador. Para crearla, copia el `server.dll` de la misma instalación de PC de donde sacaste el ejecutable del juego.
- **Rendimiento recuperado en procesadores con solo 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88, MT6769 y similares). Desde la versión anterior, todos los hilos del juego se fijaban a los núcleos rápidos. En estos procesadores eso los metía todos en solo 2 núcleos, y el juego iba peor que antes. Ahora solo se fijan cuando hay al menos 4 núcleos rápidos; si no, Android los reparte como antes.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.15: driver recomendado para tu GPU

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.
  - **MediaTek, Exynos, Tensor o Unisoc con Mali-G57 o más nueva:** PanVK (Mesa), con la misma condición.
  - **Mali-G52/G72/G76 o más antiguas:** el driver del sistema (PanVK aún es experimental en ellas).
  - **PowerVR (Moto g54, Helio G35/G37…) y Samsung Xclipse:** el driver del sistema. No hay un driver alternativo que funcione en ellas.
- **Aviso si el driver no es para tu GPU.** Si eliges un driver hecho para otra GPU (por ejemplo, Turnip en una Mali o PanVK en una Adreno), el launcher avisa de que el juego probablemente no arrancará.

La app no incluye ningún driver: los importas tú como ZIP (adrenotools) desde el mismo diálogo.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.14: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

Revisamos los reportes de la v0.1.13. La protección para GPU PowerVR funcionó: el Moto g54 ya pasa del primer dibujo. Esta versión corrige el cierre más repetido y hace que los reportes traigan la información que necesitamos.

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.

releases.name: Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13
releases.body:
## Most Wanted Android Evolved v0.1.13: mega actualización

Revisamos uno por uno los reportes y los zip de diagnóstico que nos enviaron. Esta versión corrige los fallos más repetidos y añade lo necesario para que los próximos reportes traigan toda la información.

### Gráficos

- **Detalle de las sombras ya se puede activar.** El juego solo habilita esa opción con tarjetas NVIDIA o ATI. Ahora el port se presenta como una NVIDIA GeForce 7800 GTX, así que la opción se puede subir y las sombras se dibujan en carrera.
- **Texturas DXT1 con transparencia correcta.** Se convierten a A1R5G5B5, como ya hace Carbon: menos memoria y bordes recortados correctos.
- **Protección para GPU PowerVR (MediaTek, p. ej. Moto g54 / Dimensity 7020).** El driver Vulkan de MediaTek se caía al crear el primer pipeline gráfico, en los cuatro juegos. Ahora, si el driver falla, el port reintenta con configuraciones más simples hasta encontrar una que funcione. *No hemos podido probarlo en un teléfono PowerVR; si tienes uno, cuéntanos cómo va.*

### Estabilidad

releases.name: 2.1 - November 18, 2026
releases.body: * **Start straight into a game (Wii).** Name a game when you launch DOSBox Wii and it starts with that game's config on top of `dosbox.conf`: from the Homebrew Channel (`<arguments>` in `meta.xml`) or from WiiFlow, either as a plugin (the zip now includes `wiiflow/plugins/dosbox-wii.ini`, which lists the `.conf` files in `DOSBox/Games` as games) or from its Homebrew list. A game can be named as `-gameconf <conf or folder>`, as a bare `.conf`, or as a bare folder that holds one (`autoboot.conf`, or its only `.conf`). A relative name is looked for as written, beside the launched `boot.dol`, then in the `DOSBox` folder, so a game's `.conf`, `.map` and files can all live in one folder, anywhere. If the game cannot be found DOSBox starts without one and says why on the DOS screen. The **Status** page has an **Autoboot** row, and the app now knows it was started this way (`IsAutoboot()`), ready for a single-game menu later. See the README's *Starting a game at launch*

releases.name: 2.0 - October 25, 2026
releases.body:
* **A new port.** DOSBox Wii has been rebuilt on the same [libgui](https://github.com/dborth/libgui) interface and driver framework as the other GX emulators, and no longer uses SDL. The DOSBox core is stock SVN r4301, and one codebase now builds for both the Wii and the Wii U
* **Wii U release!** DOSBox Wii now runs natively on the Wii U as its own app, with its own icon on the Wii U Menu. Requires [Aroma](https://wiiu.hacks.guide/) - run the latest Aroma release and launch the `.wuhb` directly from it
  * Full **Wii U GamePad** support - touch screen and buttons - alongside Wiimote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller and Wii U Pro Controller
  * SD card plus up to 3 USB drives, mounted from the new **Drives** screen. USB supports FAT32, exFAT and NTFS (requires [Mocha](https://github.com/wiiu-env/MochaPayload), an optional Aroma component)
  * Recommended: install [Bloopair](https://github.com/GaryOderNichts/Bloopair) to pair Bluetooth controllers (Switch Pro, Joy-Con, DualShock/DualSense, Xbox, and more) as if they were a Wii U Pro Controller

releases.body:
## 核心变更

### 1. Flyme 12.6 / Android 16 反孤儿进程根治（`libsubreaper.so`）
- 经魅族 21 Note（Flyme 12.6 / Android 16）控制变量实测，系统会在 `< 100ms` 内静默终止普通应用 UID 下托孤给 `init`（`PPID=1`）的孤儿进程。
- 内置 368 字节纯静态 PIE（`ET_DYN`、64KB 对齐）AArch64 启动器 `lib/arm64-v8a/libsubreaper.so`，通过 `prctl(PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER, 1)` 接管整个 Wine 进程子树并循环 `wait4(-1)` 回收已退出子进程（含 `-EINTR` 重试，兼容暂停/恢复）。
- 通过 `ImageFs.find(Context)` → `ProcessHelper.initNativeLibDir()` → `ProcessHelper.wrapWithSubreaper()` 接入启动链，彻底移除早期写死 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地二进制补丁与 `wineserver -f -p` 预启动变通方案。
- **实测结果**：使用原版未修改 `ntdll.so` 即可进入容器，`wineserver`、`services.exe`、`winedevice.exe`、`plugplay.exe`、`rpcss.exe`、`explorer.exe` 全程挂载在 `libsubreaper.so` 下存活且零僵尸进程；不再局限于 `proton-9.0-arm64ec`，实测 `proton-9.0-x86_64` 也可正常进入容器。

### 2. 手柄无响应问题修复（虚拟手柄 / XInput）
- `services.exe` 与 `winedevice.exe`（承载 `winebus.sys`、`winehid.sys`、`winexinput.sys`、`libSDL2`、`libfakeinput.so`）在 `wineboot.exe` 退出后不再因成为孤儿被系统击杀，手柄驱动链路保持存活。
- 修正 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中正常/精简模式将 `winebus` / `winehid` 设为禁用（`Start=4`）的问题，改为 `Start=3`，并升级配置标记为 `startupSelection_v4` 使旧容器启动时自动修复注册表。

### 3. 注册表与 Wine 开始菜单汉化补齐

- 通过 `ImageFs.find(Context)` → `ProcessHelper.initNativeLibDir()` → `ProcessHelper.wrapWithSubreaper()` 接入启动链，彻底移除早期写死 `proton-9.0-arm64ec/lib/wine/aarch64-unix/ntdll.so` 的原地二进制补丁与 `wineserver -f -p` 预启动变通方案。
- **实测结果**：使用原版未修改 `ntdll.so` 即可进入容器，`wineserver`、`services.exe`、`winedevice.exe`、`plugplay.exe`、`rpcss.exe`、`explorer.exe` 全程挂载在 `libsubreaper.so` 下存活且零僵尸进程；不再局限于 `proton-9.0-arm64ec`，实测 `proton-9.0-x86_64` 也可正常进入容器。

### 2. 手柄无响应问题修复（虚拟手柄 / XInput）
- `services.exe` 与 `winedevice.exe`（承载 `winebus.sys`、`winehid.sys`、`winexinput.sys`、`libSDL2`、`libfakeinput.so`）在 `wineboot.exe` 退出后不再因成为孤儿被系统击杀，手柄驱动链路保持存活。
- 修正 `WineUtils.changeServicesStatus()` 中正常/精简模式将 `winebus` / `winehid` 设为禁用（`Start=4`）的问题，改为 `Start=3`，并升级配置标记为 `startupSelection_v4` 使旧容器启动时自动修复注册表。

### 3. 注册表与 Wine 开始菜单汉化补齐

Stereoscopic 3D, nothing missing in wide views anymore, and a log for every play session.

If 2.0.9 left the app in its safe graphics mode after a crash, this update clears it.

releases.name: msr2ds 2.0.9
releases.body:

Mostly Android fixes, and faster lighting everywhere.

- **Android: "Not built yet" with the native code in place** (#58, #63). On some devices (an Odin 3 in #58), Android gives a `recomp-android` folder copied in from a PC an owner the app can't read. The app now makes the `recomp-android` folder itself, so a copy from the PC goes into a folder it owns. releases.body:
# IZPSX emulator 0.5.3

IZPSX runs PlayStation games on Nintendo Switch 2 through [IZ2S](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZ2S-Platform).

## Install

### Through IZ2S App library

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.iza).
2. In IZ2S, open **App library**, import the `.iza` file, and install it to the Switch 2 SD card. IZ2S installs the emulator in `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`. The installer includes the launcher, engine, shaders, font, and interface assets.

### Directly to the SD card

1. Download [`izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip`](https://github.com/byizmysh/IZPSX-emulator/releases/download/v0.5.3/izpsx-emulator-0.5.3.zip).
2. Extract the ZIP to the root of the Switch 2 SD card so `iz2s/` sits at the top level. The archive includes the emulator files and empty `bios/`, `games/`, and `saves/` folders under `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/`.

Preserve your BIOS, games, memory cards, and settings when updating.

## BIOS and games

| File | SD card path |
| --- | --- |
| Your own PlayStation BIOS, exactly **512 KiB (524,288 bytes)** | `SD:/iz2s/modules/izpsx/bios/bios.bin` |

Low battery and disconnect warnings, an accurate battery percentage, and rumble on the GameCube controller.

## What's new

- **The app warns you when a controller's battery runs low.** You get a notification naming the player and controller, and the controller beeps when it reaches your chosen level (10% by default, with an optional earlier warning). Both are switches in Settings.
- **The app tells you when a controller disconnects.** The notification names the player and says if the battery ran out, and it clears when the controller reconnects. You can turn it off in Settings.
- **The battery percentage is accurate all the way down.** It comes from a measured full discharge of a Joy-Con 2 pair, so 50% means half your play time is left, and a brief dip during rumble doesn't change it.
- **The NSO GameCube controller rumbles.** Game rumble now reaches its motor.

## Install

Download `joycon2android-3.2.0.apk` below and install it over your existing copy. See the [README](https://github.com/JoeGeC/joycon2android#setup-guide) for the full setup guide.

releases.name: 1.0.0 Risshun
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这是 `1.0.0` 首个正式版。电脑端改用系统 WebView2 并提供安装包与便携模式，双端新增游戏封面、手动备份与按次选择写入前备份，并从本版本起保持 `1.x` 期间的设置与备份兼容。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **从 `0.x` 升级必须重新配置；Android 必须先卸载再安装。**
> - **Android 端**：本版本更换了应用签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 `0.x` 版本，请**先卸载旧版再安装 `1.0.0`**。卸载会一并删除游戏设置、目录授权和 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，升级前请先将需要保留的备份复制到其他位置，或先恢复所需存档。
> - **Windows 端**：配置与数据改存至新目录（配置位于 `%APPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`，游戏、设备和备份默认位于 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\galgame-savedata-sync\`），**不迁移 `0.x` 测试版的数据**，升级后需要重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。原 `0.x` 版本位于 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\` 的文件不会被删除，需要时可手动取回或清理。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与能力版本已更新，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接或传输。
- **从 `1.0.0` 起保持数据与备份兼容**：此后 `1.x` 版本升级将保留游戏配置、设备关联与备份，且 `1.0.0` 起写入的备份可在整个 `1.x` 内列出和恢复；两台设备需处于同一主次版本（例如均为 `1.0.x`）才能连接。若用旧版应用打开由更新版本写入的数据，应用会保持数据不变并提示安装最新版本后再打开。
- **Windows 分发包调整**：提供 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Setup-x64.exe` 安装包（支持只为当前用户或所有用户安装，缺少 WebView2 时自动下载安装）和 `SavedataSync-1.0.0-Portable-x64.zip` 免安装版（在 `SavedataSync.exe` 同级目录新建 `portable_data` 文件夹可启用便携模式，数据随程序保存）。

## 新功能

- **游戏封面**：游戏卡片可显示竖版封面。在“游戏设置”的“封面”一行中，支持从 VNDB、NextMoe、Bangumi 和 Steam 在线搜索封面（NextMoe 可先选作品再选封面），也支持从本机选取图片或移除封面；从对端导入游戏时，会一并取回对方已设置的封面。

releases.name: 0.5.0 Interconnected Devices
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版起，同一网络内的任意两台设备都能互相连接、互传存档：电脑可以连接另一台电脑，Android 也能开启本机服务，让电脑或其他手机连进来。连接后两端都能发起传输。

## 升级说明

> [!CAUTION]
> **升级后需要重新设置游戏和设备。** 配置格式已变更，读不了 0.4.0 的配置，覆盖安装后应用会报配置错误。
> 电脑端删除 `%APPDATA%\存档同步\game-library.json`；Android 清除应用数据，或卸载后重新安装。之后重新添加游戏、连接设备并关联。
> Android 清除应用数据或卸载会一并删除 `Android/data/io.github.galgame.savedatasync/files/backups/` 下的备份，需要保留时先把这个文件夹复制到其他位置。

- **两端必须一起升级**：通信协议与 0.4.0 不兼容，旧版设备会显示为版本不同，无法连接。
- **写入前备份改为默认关闭**：被覆盖的文件默认不保留，需要备份时在“设置”中开启。关闭备份时开始传输不再弹出确认。

## 新功能

- **电脑连接其他设备**：电脑的设备页会搜索附近的设备，也可以手动输入地址连接，两台电脑之间可以互传存档。已保存的设备在原地址连不上时，会按设备查找 5 秒并改用新地址。
- **Android 本机服务**：在设备页点击“启动本机服务”后显示地址和连接二维码，电脑和其他手机可以连进这台手机。服务由常驻通知保持，应用切到后台后仍能被连接、接收传输，也可以从通知停止。服务停止时可以换端口。
- **任意一端发起传输**：连接后两端都能发起传输并选择方向，包括两台 Android 之间。每台设备同一时间只连接一台设备。
- **对方自动打开传输详情**：传输开始时，另一端也会切到这次传输的详情页。
- **修改日期提示**：Android 未开启“直接读写文件”、计划里又有文件要写入手机时，计划页或传输详情会显示黄色提示，可以直接去开启权限。
- **导入游戏默认用对方的游戏名**：从另一端导入游戏时，名称默认填对方设备上的游戏名。

## 修复与改进

- Android 未开启“直接读写文件”时，电脑向手机覆盖大量文件不再随文件数成倍变慢。以前覆盖约 500 个文件、97 MiB 需要近 8 分钟。
- 附近的设备停止服务后，约 10 秒内从“附近的设备”列表消失。以前会一直显示，点“连接”才失败。
- 本机服务的端口被占用时，提示换一个端口后重试；Android 停止本机服务后马上再开启不再失败。
- 和文件无关的程序内部错误改为提示“应用内部出错，请重试；仍然失败时重启应用”，不再提示读写文件失败。

releases.name: 0.4.0 Faster Sync
releases.body:
> [!NOTE]
> 这一版主要提速：比较只看文件大小和修改日期，不再逐个计算哈希；内容边打包边发送、边收边解包，接收端的备份与传输同时进行。Android 授予“所有文件访问权限”后直接读写存档目录，扫描、备份和写入都快很多。

## 升级说明

- 可直接覆盖安装 0.3.1，设备、游戏和备份设置都会保留。备份设置格式已升级，旧版应用读不了，不支持降级。
- **两端必须一起升级**：比较和传输协议与 0.3.x 不兼容，一端是旧版时会在开始传输前提示更新两端。
- **Android 最低版本提高到 Android 11。**

## 新功能

- **按大小和修改日期比较**：两端文件大小相同、修改日期相差不超过 2 秒即视为相同，扫描只列目录，不再读取文件内容计算 SHA-256。写入后目标文件的修改日期设为来源的修改日期，下次比较显示相同。
- **流式传输**：发送端直接把文件打包进网络流，接收端边收边解包，本机不再生成快照或压缩包。数据不完整或中途断开时目标不变。
- **备份与传输并行**：接收端登记任务后马上开始备份，同时接收内容，备份完成且内容收齐后再写入。进度分为备份、传输、写入三段。
- **备份阶段显示百分比**：两端界面和 Android 通知在备份时都显示进度，不再一直转圈。
- **Android 所有文件访问权限**：授权后游戏目录直接按路径读写，不经 SAF。设置页显示授权状态并可跳到系统授权页，首次添加游戏后会提示一次；未授权时照常经 SAF 读写。

## 修复与改进

- 备份和写入去掉多余的重读、逐文件 fsync 和反复列目录，Android 扫描、备份和打包时同时打开多个文件。约 500 个文件、100 MiB 的存档目录，两端备份从约 5 分钟降到数秒。
- 备份按游戏归组：重新选择游戏目录后，旧目录的备份照常列出、参与轮换，也能恢复到当前目录。
- “重新扫描”沿用上次传输的方向，不再回到默认的电脑传移动端。
- 一端取消传输时两端都记为已取消，另一端不再显示“传输失败：网络连接中断”。
- 手机上传途中断网时两端都按网络中断结束，不再报“请求内容无效”或被电脑记为用户取消。
- 手机作为发送端时可以看到电脑的备份进度，不再一直显示“正在备份 0%”。
- 手机发送途中断网或应用被结束时，电脑不再卡住到 30 分钟期限才能开始新的比较和传输。
- 对方存档目录改名后又改回，刷新即可重新比较，不用断开重连。
- 移动端刚连上时连点“连接”不再断开刚建立的连接。
- 电脑写入途中被强制结束留下的临时文件，比较时跳过，下次写入时清理。
- 任务结果和进度文案更准确：文件、文件夹和删除分开计数；取消时没执行的文件不再算失败；结果待确认时不再显示“部分完成”；等待对方设备时有单独说明；错误写明出错的是哪一端。

releases.name: MAME4droid 2026(0.289) 1.40.6
releases.body:
## Added NetPlay Public Rooms

Until now, NetPlay worked over the internet with no account, no relay, and no service to trust. The one thing it could not do was find you an opponent: you still had to know someone already, and swap an IP address with them by hand.

**Public Rooms** is that missing half. It's an optional board where hosts advertise the game they are hosting, so anyone with the same ROM can tap it and connect.

What it is *not* is a relay. The board introduces two players and then steps out of the way — the match still runs directly between the two devices, exactly as it did before, and nothing about it passes through any server of mine. 

### On the board

* **Room codes.** Every room gets a short code you can pass to a friend. 
* **PIN rooms.** Tick *Require PIN* and the room still appears, marked as protected, but only the people you told can get in. The PIN itself never reaches the server — only a hash of it does.
* **A color-coded connection forecast.** Green, amber, or red per room, based on what STUN actually measured about both routers rather than a guess. Two symmetric NATs with no way through show red and refuse the join.

## 1.37 NetPlay

This release introduces **NetPlay**: play the same game together over Wi-Fi or the internet, built from scratch as a native part of MAME4droid rather than bolted on.

releases.body:
# STORM 3DS 1.12.0

## Русский
- **Ускорение ЦП, компилятора и фикс слайдшоу («Пропуск дублирующихся кадров»):** исправлен синхронный простой ЦП `scheduler.Finish()` в Vulkan на пропущенных кадрах (заменён на асинхронный `scheduler.Flush()`) и убраны лишние `eglSwapBuffers` на дублях в OpenGL ES; в Android release включён ThinLTO (`-flto=thin` + `lld --lto-O3`), расширен кэш ARM64 JIT (`48 -> 96 МБ` для режима 2), а по умолчанию отключён `3ds_fmv_hack` (устранявший в 8 раз более частые выходы из JIT) и выставлено нативное разрешение `1x` с авто-миграцией старых профилей.
- **Чёткий текст в играх без выпавших пикселей:** фильтрация вывода по умолчанию и профиль безопасной совместимости переведены на линейную (`video_filtering = linear` / `VideoFiltering.LINEAR` вместо `none`), что устраняет выпадение тонких 1-пиксельных строк в игровых шрифтах на дробных областях экранов 3DS (в том числе в Splinter Cell 3D).

releases.body:
This hotfix fixes a frame-rate regression at the 60 FPS cap. On the POCO F5, v0.3.5 requested a 60 Hz display mode and the Vulkan swapchain spent longer waiting for an image. ## 中文

本期新增 termux-ui 模块，为 Windows 应用、Linux 桌面、文件和运行组件提供统一图形界面。

- Windows 应用与游戏：通过独立的 Wine 环境导入、配置、管理和运行程序。
- Linux 桌面：创建、启动、管理和重新安装 Native 与 PRoot 桌面环境。
- 运行组件：下载和管理 Wine、Box64、图形及配套组件，支持自定义 Wine 和 Box64 版本。
- 文件管理：浏览文件、批量操作、查看文件信息，并将检测到的 Windows 程序导入程序库。
- 输入与显示：按程序配置显示设置、键盘鼠标输入、虚拟按键和游戏手柄。
- 备份与恢复：导出和恢复 PRoot 桌面容器、Wine 环境及 Wine C 盘。

## English

Introduce the new termux-ui module with a unified graphical interface for Windows applications, Linux desktops, files, and runtime components.

- Windows apps and games: import, configure, manage, and launch programs with dedicated Wine environments.
- Linux desktops: create, launch, manage, and reinstall Native and PRoot desktop environments.
- Runtime components: download and manage Wine, Box64, graphics, and supporting components, including custom Wine and Box64 builds.
- File management: browse files, perform batch operations, view file details, and import detected Windows programs.
- Input and display: configure per-program display settings, keyboard and mouse input, virtual controls, and game controllers.
- Backup and recovery: export and restore PRoot desktop containers, Wine environments, and Wine C drives.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.1
releases.body:
This release adds a bundled driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite, brings back the audio presets that were missing from 0.6.0, fixes DLC imports and GPU hangs, lets each touch control be resized, and redesigns the launcher.

## Graphics

- **Adreno 8xx driver for Snapdragon 8 Elite.** A source-built Mesa 26.3 Turnip with a fix for the newer Qualcomm gralloc, which otherwise leaves the whole image garbled on Adreno 830. Auto selects it on SM8750 devices unless an imported driver is chosen, and it always renders with `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,nobin`. On Adreno 830 it measured about 12 ms of GPU time per frame at 100% resolution, compared with about 26 ms on the stock driver. Other Adreno 8xx GPUs can select it manually; it has only been validated on Adreno 830.
- **High refresh rate displays.** The game requests the display's fastest mode and passes the FPS option to Android, so FPS settings above 60 are no longer capped at 60 by vsync on 120 Hz phones.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.6.0
releases.body:
- Fixed DLC imports after the base game is installed, including DLC-only ZIPs/folders and ZIPs left in to_install by older builds (issue #162). Packs are hash-checked in a temporary tree before replacement; previous packs can be recovered after an interrupted replacement.
- Accepted HMM JSON schemas with trailing commas, comments and a UTF-8 BOM; schema errors no longer dump the complete file (issue #93).
- Added a persisted game-storage choice for internal memory, app folders and Android/media folders on mounted volumes, including SD cards. Optional verified copying keeps the original game, mods, settings and saves (issue #90).
- Added missing translations in English, Russian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese and Portuguese, including mod settings, updates, storage selection and localized file/installer errors.
- Fixed overlapping guest memory copies with `memmove`, addressing the ring crash and broken collision triggers (PR #158 fix by [puopg (Michael Chen)](https://github.com/puopg)).
- Removed the earlier small-block quarantine and collision repair workarounds alongside that fix (PR #158).

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.3
releases.body:
small update

### Vulkan driver profiles

- Added **Adreno 8xx Experimental (sysmem+flushall)** as a separate, non-default launcher choice.
- The new profile uses the bundled whitebelyash Mesa 26.2 gen8-capable driver and forces the exact `TU_DEBUG=sysmem,flushall` workaround for artifact-prone Adreno 8xx devices.

### Android audio presets

- Added an experimental **POCO F8 Ultra (low latency)** preset. It reduces the internal FIFO cushion from 16 to 8 guest audio frames (about 85 ms to 43 ms) and requests AAudio's exclusive low-latency path to avoid HyperOS selecting an approximately 80 ms shared hardware burst.
- The existing **Default** and **AYN** behavior is unchanged. The POCO-specific path is opt-in because it may crackle, stall or lose sound on devices whose AAudio/MMAP implementation is unreliable.
- The selected preset, resolved FIFO parameters, AAudio performance/sharing modes, hardware burst, active buffer and platform xrun count are written to the Android log.

releases.name: Unleashed Recomp Android 0.5.2
releases.body:
### The fix for freezing and crashing on some devices (handhelds like AYN and some Android 13 phones) is still on development. We'll release it as soon as possible

Version 0.5.2 replaces the withdrawn 0.5.1 APK. It includes every user-facing change from 0.5.1, removes performance instrumentation that was unintentionally left enabled there, and adds the following.

### Mod settings (issue #75)

- Mods with an HMM `ConfigSchemaFile` now have their own settings button.
- Boolean, string, integer, floating-point and custom-enum fields are supported, including descriptions, defaults and numeric limits.
- Settings are saved atomically to the mod's INI without discarding unrelated sections, keys or comments.

### In-app updates (issue #83)

- Added periodic update checks and a manual **Check for updates** button.
- The launcher shows release notes and download progress, verifies GitHub's SHA-256 digest when present, and rejects APKs with a different package name or Android signing certificate.
- Installation is handed to Android's system installer; game files, saves, mods and settings stay in place.

### ISO / update / DLC installation (PR #78)

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 366 (7e2316d)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 341

Built from nx2 at 7e2316d429. It includes everything testers ran in all-in-one builds 11, 13 and 14, plus the fixes that landed after them.

### Big points
- **A third GPU thread.** Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws are now recorded on a third thread, ported from Fritchii (Frizti). It's always on (#2319). GPU submits are lighter (#2312), and the GPU threads sleep instead of spinning while they wait (#2237, #2247).
- **Switch 2 Editions run as Switch 2.** Kirby and the Forgotten Land, Xenoblade Chronicles 2 / DE / X, Mario Wonder, Metroid Prime 4 and other Editions boot with their Switch 2 identity. Matching upgrade packs layer correctly over the game, and launches work from a .nup, a loose folder or a packed update (#2328, #2329, #2332, #2338, #2340). Bundled NUP updates show in Add-Ons (#2326). Xenoblade 2 gets its Switch 2 memory layout (#2327).
- **Switch 2 games in HOME without installing.** Games in your game folders appear in the native HOME Menu, with your custom artwork, and boot in their own session (#2148). There's also a HOME Button hotkey, and native HOME keeps its own isolated system data (#2183–#2201).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 341 (9c9a1df)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 316

Built from the all-in-one test build 10 (test/all-in-one-10 at 9c9a1dfa56), which testers and the maintainer ran before release: nx2 6b34d6ee13 plus every fix that was waiting for testers. These fixes are landing in nx2 now.

### Big points
- **Far fewer shader freezes, in every game.** Async shaders are now on by default with a short 8 ms wait (Bounded); choices you set yourself are kept (#2105). Compute shaders that are still compiling no longer stall the game when the screen already has an earlier result (#2104). On NVIDIA, compute shaders compile much faster (#2103), and a shader the game is waiting on no longer queues behind other builds (#2098). The pipeline cache is written safely, and a cache the driver rejects starts fresh (#2100). The second launch of the same build is almost freeze-free.
- **Cyberpunk 2077:** all 64 shaders that were rejected now translate (NVN2 root tables, surface atomics, TLD.B.LL/TXQ, USHF/REDUX/LDG) (#2089, #2090, #2093, #2094).

releases.name: Lichii nx2 build 316 (5a66c89)
releases.body:
## Changes since build 228

Built from nx2 at 5a66c8959f, the release candidate testers have been running (run 316). Build 228 was be1f4d9c84. That's 141 merged changes, 60 of them from community contributors.

### Big points
- **Nextendo online play (opt-in).** Lichii can now play online through the Nextendo Network. It's off until you turn it on: Configure → Network → Play online through Nextendo Network, then sign in (#1979, #1358, #1984).
  - **Friends list, friend requests and presence:** see who is online and add friends (#1983, #2019).
  - **Your Nextendo nickname and picture** show as the current user (#1990).
  - **One Nextendo account per user profile:** each Lichii user profile signs in on its own. If you were already signed in, you may need to sign in once more (#2011).
  - **Network fixes so games stay connected:** Splatoon 3's network requests follow the connection (#1988). Socket options games use are handled, and stray UDP resets on Windows are ignored (#1982). SSL Peek returns the waiting bytes (#2016).
  - Mario Kart 8 Deluxe must be on version 4.0.1 to play online.
